question_text: The area of the triangle shown is $4\text{ m}^2$.

subparts.stem: Given that $\theta$ is obtuse, find the value of $\theta$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Use the statistics function on a calculator to enter data and compute sample mean ($\bar{x}$) and sample standard deviation ($s_x$).
step_by_step: Enter the 12 data values into the calculator.
Identify $\bar{x} \approx 24.083 \approx 24.1$ and $s_x \approx 6.71$ (or $\sigma_x \approx 6.71$ as shown on screen).
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Rounding prematurely before writing down the final answer.

subparts.solution:
Contestants with times greater than $24.1 + 6.71 \approx 30.81\text{ minutes}$ will be eliminated.
So, the contestants who took 32 minutes and 40 minutes are immediately eliminated.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Elimination threshold is one standard deviation above the mean: $\bar{x} + s$.
step_by_step: Add one standard deviation to the mean: $24.1 + 6.71 = 30.81\text{ minutes}$.
Identify all times in the data set that are strictly greater than $30.81$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Subtracting the standard deviation instead of adding it.
